elements.label: Blue navigation drawer overlay (left menu: Consolidation, Processes, Workflow, Integration...) dismissing to reveal the Run Tasks panel

pattern.description: A translucent blue side-navigation drawer covering the left half of the app closes almost instantly (about two frames), uncovering the Import Actuals task page underneath; the rest of the screen stays still.
pattern.why_premium: Shows the real navigation path (menu to Integration > Run Tasks) without a hard cut, so the viewer keeps spatial context; the dismissal is fast enough not to stall the narration.

build_hint.gsap: gsap.to('.nav-drawer', {xPercent: -30, opacity: 0, duration: 0.08, ease: 'power2.out'}); page underneath stays static; no stagger.
build_hint.remotion: Drawer opacity = interpolate(frame, [0, 2], [1, 0], {extrapolateRight: 'clamp', easing: Easing.out(Easing.quad)}); translateX = interpolate(frame, [0, 2], [0, -30]) percent; no spring.

notes: Burst is only about two frames (energy peaks at frame 1376 and is near zero after), so this reads as screen-recorded UI rather than authored motion. Whether the drawer slides left or just fades is hard to tell at this length; fade is the dominant change. No SFX candidates.
